scope: Browser buffer ABI version 2, guest regions, build defaults, worker region offsets
method: 200 warmup operations per lane; five samples with alternating lane order; timings exclude worker messages; browser and Node runs recorded separately

static_checks: Rust clippy with unsafe lint gates
validation.template_build: Passed a temporary application build with both scalar/shared artifacts and manifest generation

replay: cd runtime-sdk/ts/browser-host && npm run bench -- --run src/linearAbi.bench.ts
cd frontend-lab && npm run test:browser -- src/browser/browserAbi.browser.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=../benchmark-results/browser_abi_report.json
limitations: Shared artifact compilation currently requires nightly and rust-src.
Shared browser execution requires cross-origin isolation.
Each allocator memory has one guest instance.
Borrowed typed arrays require explicit caller lifetime discipline.
Node full-request benchmarks include Vitest getter overhead; browser samples are authoritative here.
No claim about HTTP, database, production contention, or concurrent throughput.
